milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because chiseled_sandstone drops itself when mined with a pickaxe (no silk touch required), so the mined item ends up in the player's inventory. This is the preferred rule type for mining tasks. The scene has 2 chiseled_sandstone blocks at the center of the front wall (~0 ~0 ~4 and ~0 ~1 ~4), marked by wall torches. Mining at least 1 satisfies the task.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted iron_leggings item ends up in the player's inventory after crafting. This is the preferred rule type for crafting tasks. The player has exactly 7 iron ingots (the exact recipe requirement) and must access the crafting table at ~0 ~0 ~6 inside the sealed room, which is only reachable after mining through the chiseled_sandstone wall — enforcing the task dependency physically.
